notizie.riassunto: Funeral services company Service International (NYSE:SCI) reported revenue ahead of Wall Street’s expectations in Q3 2026, with sales up 4.6% year on year to $1.11 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $0.97 per share was 2.1% below analysts’ consensus estimates.
